written.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 models
written.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. The models are designed for open-ended technical work and generate outputs up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions.

written.headline: Meta releases Muse Ember lightweight reasoning model
written.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab released Muse Ember, its lightest and most cost-efficient AI model yet, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens. The model is designed for repetitive agent execution tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long document parsing.

written.headline: Former US DOE staffers launch modular data center firm Mavria with $130M
written.summary: Former U.S. Department of Energy staffers launched modular data center firm Mavria, raising $130 million across pre-seed and seed rounds at a $1 billion valuation. The funding was led by Paradigm, with participation from AMP PBC, Liquid 2, Critical Frontier, and Dream Ventures.

written.headline: Nvidia intervention leads to Commerce chip smuggling probe being moved to DOJ
written.summary: U.S. Commerce Department investigators probing Singapore‑based Megaspeed for diverting Nvidia AI chips to China were transferred to the Justice Department after Nvidia contacted the agency. The probe began in late 2024 following discovery of Nvidia GPUs in a Malaysian data centre.

written.headline: Apple adds $49.99 intelligence usage packs for Logic Pro AI features
written.summary: Apple introduced one‑time $49.99 Intelligence Usage Packs that let Logic Pro users extend access to cloud‑based AI assistants. The packs roll over month‑to‑month, expire after 12 months, and are expected to roll out to other Creator Studio apps later this month.
